messages:
Lee: Thanks for joining the all-hands — tossing follow-ups into this thread so we have owners and links.

Ana: Quick recap Qs: Dedicated GA timing, Private pilot status, cost playbook + Console guidance.

Jamie: Private pilot update: infra provisioning is on track but waiting on NatSec sign-off for the customer onboarding checklist. Targeting three pilot customers in June.

NatSec: We're reviewing the onboarding checklist; opened one blocker on KMS integration and one on network egress logging. Will post details by EOD Fri.

Raj: SLA tiers question: Can we offer 99.95% as standard and 99.9% as premium?

Ana: Decision: 99.95% will be default GA tier; 99.9% premium with capacity commit. Morgan to draft the SLA template.

Morgan: I'll draft SLA template. Action: Morgan -> post draft 2026-03-30 and tag Legal + Sales.

Lee: Cost/Optimize: plan is to surface batching/quantization hints in Console Q2. Action: Lee + EngInfra to produce a "Cost Playbook" and Console CTA by 2026-04-10.

Ben: Sales will need pricing guardrails for the 99.9% tier. Raj/Ben to sync this week.

Raj: Allocated time this Thurs 10am PT. Ben, can you and Legal attend?

Ben: Yes, will be there.

DeployBot: Perf-sweep job-113 finished; 2 minor mem OOMs observed on p4-8 during long-seq tests. Full logs: http://ci.internal/logs/job-113

Lee: Action owner recap:
- Morgan: SLA template + draft (2026-03-30)
- Lee & EngInfra: Cost Playbook + Console CTA (2026-04-10)
- Jamie: Private pilot update (2026-04-24)
- NatSec: KMS + egress logging blocker details (EOD Fri)
- Raj & Ben: Sales pricing sync (this Thurs)

Sasha: I'll volunteer to review the Console UX draft for the CTA.

Ana: Thanks — added. Also will follow up with release notes once perf-sweep is green.

Lee: If anything else pops up, post in this thread. Appreciate everyone jumping in! :rocket:
